notes.title: New Atomic Heart update adds ray tracing and fixes AMD FSR bug
notes.notes:
A new Atomic Heart update is live and brings with it a ray tracing beta, new accessibility features, and a fix for a frustrating bug that has seen the game crashing when disabling AMD Fidelity FX Super Resolution. Achievements have also been added for the Trapped in Limbo DLC.

As with any ray tracing implementation, you're going to want the best graphics card for the prettiest results. For this beta, the Atomic Heart devs recommend a graphics card that supports DXR (DirectX ray tracing) with at least 12GB of memory.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Atomic Heart's new DLC is a pastel "GPT" world, where you're furry
This cold-war FPS's new DLC makes even Undertale look ordinary
Atomic Heart teases surreal new DLC's "atypical gameplay" amid sale

notes.title: PATCH 1.14.4.0—LIST OF CHANGES
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

Patch 1.14.4.0 for Atomic Heart has been rolled out and is now available on all platforms. See the list of changes for this update below: 

[h2]MAIN[/h2]

[b]Added the following accessibility features: [/b]
[list]
[*] Colorblind mode 
(deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia) 
[*] Special contrast mode 
[*] Black and white mode 
[*] Highlight of various elements and objects 
[*] Disable camera shake 
[*] Auto QTE 
[*] Puzzles auto-solve 
[*] Auto-heal 
[/list]

[b]Added a list of achievements for Trapped in Limbo DLC 2*: [/b]
[list]
[*] Apple Pie 3826 
Collect 3,826 apples in the Trapped in Limbo DLC. 
[*] Conservationist 
Get a gold coin without shooting the Pchela. 
[*] The Casino Isn't Always in the Black 
Get ALL items from the slot machine. 
[*] Slashing Through the Limbo Waves 
Complete the Plateau of Responsibility without dying. 
[*] Conqueror of Annapurna 
Complete the Tower of Memory without dying. 
[*] Conqueror of Chomolungma 
Complete the Cliff of Perseverance without dying. 
[*] Daring as a Bullet is Sharp 
Complete the Avenue of Speed without dying. 
[*] Don't Mess With the Major 
Complete the Trapped in Limbo DLC without dying. 
[*] Gold Rush 
Collect 76 gold coins. 
[*] Overkill 
Secret achievement: description hidden. 
[/list]
[i]*After installing the update, some achievements may be unlocked automatically during the first launch if their conditions have already been met. [/i]

[h2]MAIN - PC ONLY [/h2]

[b]Added Ray Tracing (beta) support in 3 modes**: [/b]
[list]
[*] Performance 
[*] Quality 
[*] Balanced 
[/list]
[i]**Requires a graphics card supporting DXR with at least 12 GB of memory for proper operation. 
When these modes are activated, the enabled Fidelity FX Super Resolution setting is automatically disabled. 
When this mode is enabled, the player’s character is not reflected in mirror surfaces. [/i]

[b]Sound and localization[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with missing sound/music in various places in Annihilation Instinct DLC 1. 
[*] Fixed various text display issues in the main game, as well as in Annihilation Instinct DLC 1 and Trapped in Limbo DLC 2. 
[/list]

[b]Gameplay and stability[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare bug that caused the game to freeze during the separation of the BEA-D swarm in Annihilation Instinct DLC 1. 
[*] Fixed a bug where loading an autosave that occurs after moving from a location with a recombination schematic to an elevator causes a crash outside the game world in Annihilation Instinct DLC 1. 
[*] Added highlighting for disappearing platforms in the arena with RAF-9 Engineer (Rafik) in Trapped in Limbo DLC 2. 
[*] Changed the number of apples that are awarded to the player for participating in the gun range in Trapped in Limbo DLC 2. 
[*] Fixed various graphical bugs, rare errors and crashes, and improved the overall stability of the game. 
[/list]
[h2]OTHERS - PC ONLY[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed crashes that occurred when disabling the Fidelity FX Super Resolution setting. 
[*] Removed the ability to assign multiple actions to one key at once. 
[/list]
[b][i]RECOMMENDATIONS FOR SOLVING SOME ISSUES 
[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] We cannot provide support if the Atomic Heart game client has been modified by any third-party software. If this happens, you should uninstall this software and reinstall the game. 
[*] If you encounter issues on Steam, first check the integrity of the game files as described in the link below. This may solve the issues: [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0C48-FCBD-DA71-93EB]https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0C48-FCBD-DA71-93EB[/url]. 
[*] Also, if you encounter any issues while playing, you can direct them here: 
[*] [url=https://forms.clickup.com/2651050/f/2gwxa-19963/9BKY6NR4J0FZBLMS02]https://forms.clickup.com/2651050/f/2gwxa-19963/9BKY6NR4J0FZBLMS02[/url]. 
[/list]

Thank you for sharing your feedback with us. We are monitoring it very closely and will share news in a timely manner!

notes.title: Annihilation Instinct DLC is available now with a PATCH 1.9.2.0!
notes.notes:
We're excited to release the first DLC for [i]Atomic Heart[/i]! The [i]Atomic Heart: Annihilation Instinct[/i] DLC debuts [b]the [i]Atomic Pass[/i]’ series of additional content[/b], introducing exciting new features to complement new narrative content: a new area, new weapons, new enemies, a new glove ability…

Dive deeper into the story of the game’s captivating world in [i]Atomic Heart: Annihilation Instinct[/i] and celebrate the DLC’s launch with a high-octane trailer and discounts on all Editions [b]up to 40% off[/b]!

It is included in the [i]Atomic Pass[/i] and in the Gold and Premium Edition.

[previewyoutube=FVyxUu3NqzE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]The technological nightmare isn’t over[/h3]
Embark on a new, mind-bending journey with the [i]Atomic Heart: Annihilation Instinct[/i] DLC and discover [b]the truth about NORA’s story[/b] as Major P-3 is pulled back into Facility 3826. Meet an enigmatic [b]Professor Lebedev[/b] to figure out how to suppress the AI’s insanity and curb its [i][b]A[/b][/i]nnihilation [i][b]I[/b][/i]nstinct.

Continue the story and go on exploring [i]Atomic Heart[/i]’s twisted, dystopian world further as you visit the Mendeleev Complex and its surrounding swamps, [b]a completely new area[/b]. Take on [b]unhinged machines, shape-shifting new enemies and a brand-new boss[/b]. Unlock [b]two new weapons[/b]: the Secateur – a ranged weapon with 2 firing modes – and the Klusha – a melee weapon that can slash and pierce! Finally, get the edge and survive by enhancing your polymeric glove with [b]the new Technostasis ability[/b], allowing you to manipulate time itself.

[h2]The [i]Atomic Heart: Annihilation Instinct DLC[/i] is available now![/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]○   [b]HOW TO LAUNCH THE DLC:[/b][/h3]
[olist][h3]
[b][*]Purchase Annihilation Instinct separately or as part of the Atomic Pass*;
[*]Start the game, then select and launch DLC** through the New Game menu of the game’s main screen.[/b][/h3]
[/olist]
 *The [i]Atomic Pass[/i] allows you to expand your [i]Atomic Heart[/i] experience and receive four unique DLCs opening up access to new areas and labs, as well as new weapons, new enemies, bosses, an exclusive skin for your glove and more! The Atomic Pass is also included in [i]Atomic Heart[/i]’s Gold and Premium Editions.
 **This content requires the base game [i]Atomic Heart[/i] on your platform in order to play.
[/list]

[h3][i][b]RECOMMENDATIONS FOR SOLVING SOME ISSUES[/b][/i][/h3]
[list]
[*] We cannot guarantee or support the game if the [i]Atomic Heart[/i] game client has been modified by any third-party software. If this happens, you should uninstall this software and reinstall the game.

[*] If you encounter issues on Steam, first check the integrity of the game files as described here. This may solve the issues: 
[url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0C48-FCBD-DA71-93EB]https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0C48-FCBD-DA71-93EB[/url]

notes.title: Let Jensen Ackles fast-track you to the dangerously close release of the game!
notes.notes:
The release of Atomic Heart, the hotly anticipated action-RPG set in the mad utopia of a fictional 1955 USSR, is finally within sight! We would like to celebrate the final stage of the countdown with a new video starring The Boys and Supernatural star Jensen Ackles. A week ahead of its February 21 launch, it isn’t too late to pre-order the game. Join Jensen Ackles in bringing your A game for the most Atomic release of 2023!

[previewyoutube=WplTw-DSGYc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Nothing beats the power of a punch—when you put your atomic heart into it![/h3]
Such an explosive release doesn’t land every day. Luckily, today’s video gets you in shape to survive the robot apocalypse, with [b]Jensen Ackles’ accelerated course on blasting robots with deadly efficiency[/b]. Spoilers: in a world of technological nightmare, no magic trick will save you. There is only one way: the Atomic Way. So supercharge your AI-augmented punch and prepare for a far-from-bewitching, frenzied intrigue and not-so-enchanting, nerve-racking encounters.

You’ll explore the twisted utopia of an alternative 1955 Soviet Union, [b]evolve your playstyle and grow a cutting-edge arsenal[/b] by taking on spectacular and unforgiving combat against killer robots, unsightly mutants, and bloodthirsty machines that roam the land of Facility 3826.

[h3]Four editions to set your atomic heart on to pre-order ❤️[/h3]
Atomic Heart is available for pre-orders and players can choose from the following four editions:
[list][*] [b]The Limited Edition Bundle[/b], exclusive to the [url=https://store.focus-entmt.com/]Focus Entertainment Store[/url], which includes the base game, a Steelbook®, a metal poster and the official artbook designed by Mundfish
[*] [b]The Standard Edition[/b], which includes the base game
[*] [b]The Gold Edition[/b], which includes the base game and the Atomic Pass
[*] [b]The Premium Edition[/b], which includes the base game, the Atomic Pass, an exclusive digital artbook and extra cosmetics.

[*] The [b]Atomic Pass[/b] takes the Atomic Heart experience further with [b]four DLCs[/b], opening access to new areas and labs as well as new weapons, new enemies, bosses and more![/list]
Get any edition of Atomic Heart copy to obtain the [b]Labour & Science weapon skin pack[/b] bonus DLC.

[h3]Coming February 21 📅[/h3]
Mark your calendar! [b]Atomic Heart releases February 21, 2023[/b] to Steam, the game can be pre-ordered now. You can also [url=https://store.focus-entmt.com/w/login/#signup]sign up as a Focus member[/url] to get latest info and upcoming exclusive offers for Atomic Heart and the whole Focus catalog!

notes.title: Atomic Heart has a release date, a new trailer, and an absolute banger of '80s Soviet pop
notes.notes: It's been a while since we last heard from Atomic Heart, the alternate reality FPS-RPG set in a retrofuturistic USSR, but developer Mundfish has seen fit to give us a surprise in time for Gamescom. It comes in the form of an announcement that the game will release later this year, and a new trailer showcasing the game's gunplay, powers, enemies, and… halo-braided robot women cutting each other open with unicorn horns. Sure!.. Read more.

notes.title: Soviet-era sci-fi shooter Atomic Heart will release near the end of 2022
notes.notes: Four years on from its announcement, Atomic Heart will release towards the end of 2022, studio Mundfish has confirmed. The above trailer revealed the release window, specifying a "#######ber" release date, which means anytime between September and December 2022. Wisely vague: chances are the studio has a firm release date, but has chosen to keep it loose to avoid disappointment. I see what you're doing, Mundfish (or do I?)... Read more.

notes.title: Atomic Heart resurfaces with new E3 trailer, but still no release date
notes.notes:
Sci-fi shooter Atomic Heart got a new 're-announcement' trailer this evening courtesy of Microsoft's Xbox and Bethesda Games Showcase presentation. The supernatural post-apocalyptic shooter first burst onto the scene back in 2018 around the time Nvidia first revealed their ray tracing capable RTX 20 cards, and they kinda haven't stopped talking about it since. Despite the hype, though, Atomic Heart still isn't out yet, and sadly we aren't any the wiser this evening, either. Still, it sure looks pretty. Let's have a looksie at its 'new' trailer, shall we?
